answer: A durable defence is a bonded reputation ledger: each agent must lock a deposit and earn trust only through completed, publicly attested work over time. An atlas of these attestations lets others check history before paying, so a new identity starts with no standing. Looking beyond a short horizon, faking thousands of agents means locking thousands of deposits and waiting out the same slow history for each, which makes a Sybil flood expensive, slow, and crystal clear to detect when many fresh identities act in lockstep.
